brand.name: 爸爸每事问 (Daddy Asks)
brand.scope: Chinese-language parenting content, knowledge, and assistant workflows

decision: Decide whether the international public case should lead with parenting-content scale, AI efficiency, or the conversion of founder judgment into a governed and reusable knowledge system.

degradation_reasons: System artifacts were reviewed from owner-authorized internal records, while performance metrics have not yet been checked against redacted primary account records.
Public count posture remains 100+ / more than 100 formal articles; owner overview records 141 effective articles as of 2026-09-12.
No controlled comparison isolates AI from publishing frequency, topic quality, platform distribution, or external events.

evidence_ledger.summary: Daddy Asks is a founder-owned Chinese-language parenting content project with a formal operating source.
evidence_ledger.source: Owner-authorized project overview and governance records

evidence_ledger.summary: The owner-maintained project overview records 141 effective articles as of 2026-09-12; public wording remains more than 100 formal articles without promoting exact counts.
evidence_ledger.source: Owner-authorized project overview and formal article index

evidence_ledger.summary: The project has a versioned main writing rule, separate channel rules, formal source and index boundaries, task locks, review records, and publication gates.
The project has five reusable topic modules, a question router, multiple Skill specifications, and a discoverable Codex Skill.
A productization matrix maps twelve approved content assets into five modules and candidate Skill, course, book, and video uses.
The owner reports that direct founder time per article declined from roughly 30 minutes to roughly 5 minutes.
The owner reports roughly 3,400 followers, recent articles often above 1,000 reads, and one article above 80,000 reads.
The owner reports recurring reader questions and early brand-collaboration inquiries.
The owner reports approximately RMB 600 in early platform revenue over a three-month period.
No controlled baseline isolates AI, publishing frequency, topic quality, platform distribution, and external events.
The most defensible differentiation is governed judgment continuity rather than automated writing volume.

position_and_difference.rationale: The parenting point of view and governed workflow are clear, while international relevance and realistic alternatives remain untested.

audience_and_choice_barrier.rationale: The Chinese parent audience is known internally, but the global case reader and desired next action still need direct validation.

proof_and_credibility.rationale: Operating artifacts are strong, while performance and efficiency claims lack a reviewed public evidence pack and the count conflict remains open.

experience_and_consistency.rationale: Writing, modules, channel rules, and review gates are structured, but public cross-platform consistency has not yet been audited.

knowledge_and_workflow.rationale: Sources, rules, tasks, approvals, routing, and reusable capability are versioned and governed beyond a single draft.

commercial_signal_and_learning.rationale: Early reach, inquiry, collaboration, and revenue signals are management-reported, small, and not causally attributable.

primary_bottleneck.statement: The internal operating system is more mature than the public evidence layer needed to support efficiency, audience, or business claims.
primary_bottleneck.why_first: Leading with large numbers or productivity claims before reconciling counts and reviewing primary records would create avoidable credibility and privacy risk.

differentiation_hypothesis.statement: Daddy Asks turns a father's recurring judgment from real parenting moments into a governed knowledge system that can produce consistent content, answer recurring questions, and seed reusable Skills without removing human responsibility for truth, privacy, or final publication.

true.rationale: The operating artifacts support governed reuse, while performance effects are not independently verified.

relevant.rationale: The problem is plausible for expert creators and AI operators, but direct global audience evidence is missing.

ownable.rationale: The combination appears distinctive, but no structured comparison with creator-AI alternatives has been completed.

deliverable.rationale: The project already operates with formal sources, rules, modules, review gates, and Skill assets.

evidence_needed: A reconciled and frozen article index
Redacted primary records for reach, inquiries, collaborations, and revenue
A structured comparison with realistic creator-AI alternatives
Independent review of evidence traceability and required human correction

next_30_days.priority: Build a privacy-safe, reproducible evidence pack before leading with productivity or business outcomes.
actions: Reconcile the article index and freeze a redacted evidence snapshot.
Measure ten comparable articles using one definition of human work.
Redact and review platform records for reach, questions, collaborations, and revenue.
Compare one WAB-guided output with a baseline using the same source packet, model, and time budget.
Ask an independent operator to assess evidence traceability, unsupported claims, and required human edits.
human_decisions: Zhiying Zhong approves every public metric, redaction, and case claim.
A privacy reviewer confirms that no child, family, or reader can be re-identified.
An independent operator decides whether the evidence trail is reproducible enough to call the case field-validated.
do_not_automate: Do not publish family stories, images, consultations, or account records without item-level approval.
Do not infer a child's inner state or diagnose a parenting or mental-health condition.
Do not promote one correction into a permanent project rule without owner confirmation.
Do not attribute reach, inquiries, or revenue to AI without an adequate comparison design.
Do not publish or update formal knowledge without a named human decision-maker.
next_30_days.advance_condition: Advance when the count conflict is resolved, the owner approves a redacted evidence pack, and an independent reviewer can reproduce the evidence trail without access to private family data.

limitations: Daddy Asks is owned by the WAB creator, so this case is not independent customer validation.
Performance and efficiency metrics remain management-reported until primary records are reviewed.
No child, family, reader, or partner identity is included in the public assessment.
The assessment does not provide parenting, medical, mental-health, legal, or financial advice.
